statement: The proportion of SUID cases with hospital overnight stays increased from 2008 to 2019.
rationale: This study can analyze trends in hospital overnight stay history among SUID cases using ncfrp_v51 and reference data from prams_p7_arf and prams_p8_arf. However, it must acknowledge its limitations regarding causal inference and incidence rate estimation.
prior_art: SUID_manuscript_v9_clean.C6 discusses trends in PCA-aligned incidence but does not focus on hospital overnight stay trends. bedsharing_ms_v7.C13 examines developmental timing of SUID incidence and associations with bed sharing, smoking, and prematurity; the proposed study is distinct as it focuses specifically on hospital stays.
required_concepts: hospital overnight stay history among SUID cases
trends in hospital stays among live-born infants
cannot_establish: The design cannot establish incidence rates or risk ratios. It can only compare proportions of SUID cases with and without hospital overnight stays across different years.
